entries.title: Genesis 27:1
segments: And it happened when Isaac [was] old and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called his oldest son Esau and said to him, My son. And he said to him, Behold, I [am] here.

entries.title: Genesis 27:2
segments: And he said to him, Behold, here am I. And he said, Behold now, I am old, I do not know the day of my death.

entries.title: Genesis 27:3
segments: And now please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field and hunt game for me.

entries.title: Genesis 27:4
segments: And make tasty meat for me, such as I love, and bring to me so that I may eat, that my soul may bless you before I die.

entries.title: Genesis 27:5
segments: And Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game in order to bring [it].

entries.title: Genesis 27:6
segments: And Rebekah spoke to her son Jacob, saying, Behold, I heard your father speak to your brother Esau, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 27:7
segments: Bring me game, and make me delicious things so that I may eat and bless you before the LORD before my death.

entries.title: Genesis 27:8
segments: And now, my son, obey my voice according to what I command you.

entries.title: Genesis 27:9
segments: Go now to the flock, and bring me from there two good kids of the goats. And I will make them delicious things for your father, such as he loves.

entries.title: Genesis 27:10
segments: And you shall bring it to your father so that he may eat, and that he may bless you before his death.

entries.title: Genesis 27:11
segments: And Jacob said to his mother Rebekah, Behold, Esau my brother [is] a hairy man, and I [am] a smooth man.

entries.title: Genesis 27:12
segments: My father will perhaps feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver. And I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

entries.title: Genesis 27:13
segments: And his mother said to him, Your curse [be] upon me, my son, only obey my voice and go bring them to me.

entries.title: Genesis 27:14
segments: And he went. And he took them and brought to his mother. And his mother made delicious things such as his father loved.

entries.title: Genesis 27:15
segments: And Rebekah took the clothes of her older son Esau, the costly ones which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob her younger son.

entries.title: Genesis 27:16
segments: And she put the skins from the kids of the goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

entries.title: Genesis 27:17
segments: And she gave the delicious things and the bread which she had prepared into the hand of her son Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 27:18
segments: And he came to his father and said, My father! And he said, Here I [am]; who are you, my son?

entries.title: Genesis 27:19
segments: And Jacob said to his father, I [am] Esau your first-born. I have done as you asked me. Arise, I pray you, sit and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me.

entries.title: Genesis 27:20
segments: And Isaac said to his son, How [is it] that you have found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD your God brought [it] to me.

entries.title: Genesis 27:21
segments: And Isaac said to Jacob, Come near, I pray you, so that I may feel you, my son, whether you are truly my son Esau or not.

entries.title: Genesis 27:22
segments: And Jacob went near to Isaac his father. And he felt him and said, The voice [is] Jacob's voice, but the hands the hands of Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 27:23
segments: And he did not know him because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau's hands. And he blessed him.

entries.title: Genesis 27:24
segments: And he said, [Are] you truly my son Esau? And he said, I [am].

entries.title: Genesis 27:25
segments: And he said, Bring [it] to me, and I will eat of my son's game, so that my soul may bless you. And he brought [it] near to him, and he ate. And he brought him wine, and he drank.

entries.title: Genesis 27:26
segments: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near now and kiss me, my son.

entries.title: Genesis 27:27
segments: And he came near and kissed him. And he smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son [is] as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.

entries.title: Genesis 27:28
segments: And may God give you of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and wine.

entries.title: Genesis 27:29
segments: Let people serve you, and let nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and let your mother's sons bow down to you. Cursed [be] everyone that curses you, and blessed [be] he that blesses you.

entries.title: Genesis 27:30
segments: And it happened, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was scarcely gone from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

entries.title: Genesis 27:31
segments: And he also had made tasty meat and brought to his father. And he said to his father, Let my father arise and eat of his son's game so that your soul may bless me.

entries.title: Genesis 27:32
segments: And his father Isaac said to him, Who [are] you? And he said, I [am] your son, your first-born, Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 27:33
segments: And Isaac trembled with a great trembling, and said, Who then [was] the one who has hunted deer and brought to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yea, he shall be blessed!

entries.title: Genesis 27:34
segments: And when Esau heard the voice of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said to his father, Bless me, me also, O my father!

entries.title: Genesis 27:35
segments: And he said, Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.

entries.title: Genesis 27:36
segments: And he said, [It is] because his name [is] called Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright, and behold, now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Have you not reserved a blessing for me?

entries.title: Genesis 27:37
segments: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, Behold! I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given him for servants. And with grain and wine I have supported him. And what shall I do now to you, my son?

entries.title: Genesis 27:38
segments: And Esau said to his father, Have you but one blessing, my father? Bless me, me also, my father. And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

entries.title: Genesis 27:39
segments: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold! Your dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth and of the dew of heaven from above.

entries.title: Genesis 27:40
segments: And by your sword you shall live, and shall serve your brother. And it shall be when you shall have the dominion, you shall break his yoke from off your neck.

entries.title: Genesis 27:41
segments: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him. And Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning [for] my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 27:42
segments: And these words of her older son Esau were told to Rebekah. And she sent and called her younger son Jacob, and said to him, Behold, your brother Esau is going to ease himself on you, to kill you.

entries.title: Genesis 27:43
segments: And now, my son, obey my voice and arise. Flee for yourself to my brother Laban, to Haran,

entries.title: Genesis 27:44
segments: and stay with him a few days until your brother's fury turns away,

entries.title: Genesis 27:45
segments: until your brother's anger turns away from you and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I also be bereaved of both of you [in] one day?

entries.title: Genesis 27:46
segments: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, like these of the daughters of the land, what good is [my] life to me?
